findings.text: the fragment is compared against a command the test builds from installer.hook_script_path() itself, so a regression that moves the script into another directory while keeping its filename leaves all ten tests green - I applied that mutation in a scratch copy (with_name(HOOK_SCRIPT_NAME) replaced by parent/"nested"/HOOK_SCRIPT_NAME) and the file reported 10 passed, the log is at the run directory as review-negctl-hook-script-path.log, and the consequence is a settings file that invokes a script which does not exist while this node's gate reports nothing.
